title: HC:// Canonical Record v1
description: Structural contract for versioned HC:// canonical JSON records. Conformance is advisory evidence and does not establish truth, identity, signature validity, or governance approval.

schema_version.description: Version identifier for this canonical record contract.

record_type.description: Declared record category; it does not prove issuer or witness authority.

witness_type.description: Declared witness category; it is not cryptographic witness verification.

author.description: Declared author name or identifier; schema conformance does not verify identity.

content.description: Record content hashed under the declared content_hash_profile.

content_hash.description: Lowercase SHA-256 digest of content under content_hash_profile.

content_hash_profile.description: Versioned content-to-bytes profile used before SHA-256 hashing.

verification_status.description: Record lifecycle label within this schema; it is not a truth verdict.

version.description: Content or revision version distinct from schema_version.

supersedes.description: Canonical record identifier superseded by this revision.

previous_hash.description: Lowercase SHA-256 digest declared for the prior revision payload.

revision_timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp indicating when a revision was issued.
